reading.title: A Day in the Kitchen
reading.text: On Sunday my mother makes breakfast for the whole family. Dad makes coffee and I make tea. After breakfast I make my bed and tidy my room. In the afternoon my sister makes a film on her phone. She asks us to be quiet, but my little brother makes a lot of noise and makes a mess in the living room. This makes my mother angry. In the evening we make dinner together. My father says that cooking with the family makes him happy. I made a mistake today. I put salt in the tea instead of sugar! Everyone laughed.

reading.title: Visitors at My House
reading.text: Last Saturday we had a lot of visitors. In the morning my uncle came from Samarkand. He knocked at the door and I said, "Come in!" He came into the living room with two big bags. In the afternoon my friend Dilya came along with her sister. We all went to the park together. In the evening everybody came back home tired. My cousin came home very late because he was clubbing. My mother was angry. She said, "What time did you come home?" He said, "About three o'clock." She said, "That is much too late!"

reading.title: How Long Does It Take?
reading.text: Alan and Grace both work in the city centre, but their journeys are different. It takes Alan twenty minutes to get to work. He takes the bus. Grace lives farther away, so it takes her forty five minutes. She takes the train. Yesterday it took Grace one hour because the train was late. At the weekend, Alan takes his camera and takes photos in the park. Grace takes an English course on Saturday mornings. She has to take an exam at the end of the course. She says, "It takes a lot of time to learn a language, but it is worth it."

reading.title: Thank You for the Apples
reading.text: Last Sunday my neighbour, Mrs Karimova, visited us. She brought a basket of apples from her garden. She always brings us something when she comes. Last time she brought flowers. My mother said, "Thank you, they are delicious. Can you bring some more next time?" Mrs Karimova laughed and said yes. Then she saw my book on the table. "It looks interesting," she said. I said, "Take it with you and read it. You can bring it back on Friday." She took the book home. On Friday she brought it back with a small cake for me.

reading.title: Getting Home
reading.text: Yesterday I went to the city to get a newspaper and a stamp. It started to rain and I began to get wet. Then it started to get dark. I was tired and I wanted to get home. I could not get a taxi, so I took the bus. When I got home, my mother said that my sister was ill. We called a doctor. The doctor said she will get better in a few days. In the evening my cousin called with good news. He has got a new job and he is getting married in April. We were very happy for him.
